$Comment: A night errand on Old Jack's errands board (Hallows_Eve_Errands), half of his board's Soul Sweep: half the souls, and half its flat pay, with the board's own pay table on top. Its Boards entry names the errands board and its night band, which replaces the base's whole list. Lost Souls drift out in the wild after dark, only while the event runs. It writes its own Rewards.Claim because a child's list replaces the base's whole: the pay waits at the errands board until the player collects it. MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row (Defense XP for the fight) carries its own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, which leaves the row out on a server without that mod while the rest of the errand pays.
